payload.claim: Acceptance criterion 2 requires 'A run whose reports are all descents exits 0', but no witness ever builds a scenario where a taken directory's reports are non-empty and consist only of 'descends into' entries with no 'enumerates' entry. In every test (test_enumerators_takes_its_directories_..., test_enumerators_reports_the_tests_..., test_enumerators_lists_the_calls_...), every directory that gets any report also independently gets a direct self-match 'enumerates' report (from `outer/pkg/added`'s case_six.py calls, or `outer/pkg`'s self-matching listdir/rglob/glob calls); the only exit-0 cases tested are zero-directories and zero-reports-at-all. So deleting the `if kind == "enumerates":` guard and setting `exit_code = 1` unconditionally whenever any report is printed (descent included) would violate the stated acceptance criterion while every existing test still passes, because no test isolates a pure-descent-only directory.
